name: The Upper Shelves: Prey
source:
It has been a week since Henry saw something he shouldn't, on the Upper Shelves, a city built out of an ancient mobile platform. He saw a strange wolf, known cryptically as the Hunter, get shot down in the street. As his mind drifts into Pandora's Box, a night club that exists only in people's dreams, it seems that many strangers are drawn to him. Can Henry make sense of this broken world before it and its residents consume him?

[From [url=https://pandoragaming.itch.io/theuppershelves]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
亨利在上层架子上看到了他不该看到的东西，这是一座用古老的移动平台建造的城市，已经一周了。他看到一只奇怪的狼，神秘地被称为“猎人”，在街上被枪杀。当他的思绪飘入潘多拉魔盒这个只存在于人们梦中的夜店时，似乎有很多陌生人都被他吸引住了。在这个破碎的世界及其居民吞噬他之前，亨利能否理解这个破碎的世界？

[来自[url=https://pandoragaming.itch.io/theuppershelves]Itch.io[/url]]
